intuition: The rotation pivot separates two sorted ranges; comparing the midpoint with the right endpoint identifies which range contains the minimum.

brute_force.approach: Scan the array and return its smallest value.

optimal.approach: Binary search while maintaining a range containing the minimum. If mid is larger than right, discard the left half through mid; otherwise keep mid and discard the right side.

edge_cases: A one-element array is already its own minimum.
An unrotated array repeatedly keeps the left half until its first element remains.
Do not discard mid when nums[mid] may itself be the minimum.
